gnosh mcp login

  Sign in to a server at a URL that wants it. gnosh says the address to sign
  in at, and opens a browser there when it runs at a desktop (not over ssh,
  and never with --no-browser). When the browser cannot come back to this
  machine, paste the address it tried to open, and Enter. The sign-in is kept
  for every session.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp login [flags] <name>

Flags
  --no-browser
      Open no browser: only say the address to sign in at. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
